about: Renders a set of cards a person chooses one of, each with a title, a description, a circle and an optional addon row. A press anywhere on a card checks it, and a horizontal set gives every card in a row the same height.

align.about: The words at the start of the card, or centred.
align.title: Alignment

choose: Choose a delivery speed to continue.

layout.about: The circle at the end of the words, or above them.
layout.title: Layout

palette.about: Every palette on the outline look. The palette sets the checked card's edge and the circle's fill.
palette.title: Palettes

enterprise.about: Single sign-on and an audit log. Talk to sales to switch.
enterprise.title: Enterprise

starter.about: One workspace and up to three people.
starter.title: Starter

team.about: Unlimited workspaces and roles for every member.
team.title: Team

required.about: A required choice in a field. Continue without a card chosen marks the set invalid and shows the field's error text, and choosing a card clears it. The field's label names the set.
required.title: Required, in a field

size.about: The padding, the gaps, the circle and the words step together.
size.title: Sizes

same.about: Leaves before six in the evening.
same.title: Same day

stacked.about: `layout="stacked"` puts the circle above the words and `align="center"` centres them, for a short choice such as a billing cycle. The addon states what the choice gives.
stacked.title: Stacked and centred

states.about: One card chosen, an invalid set with none chosen, and a disabled set. A disabled card rests on the subtle surface.
states.title: States

title: Radio card

variant.about: Every look with Next day checked. `solid` fills the checked card, `subtle` deepens a muted card, `surface` tints the checked card and `outline` sets its edge.
variant.title: Looks

vertical.about: A vertical set in a phone's width. Enterprise is disabled, because it needs a call with sales. The input of each card lists its description in `aria-describedby`.
vertical.title: Vertical set
